findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe YAML deserialization
 * @description Using yaml.load or yaml.unsafe_load with untrusted data can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-yaml-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe YAML deserialization that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe YAML deserialization via yaml.load or yaml.unsafe_load
